howToApply: Visit the official ONGC website at www.ongcindia.com to register on the registration web link.

Candidates can apply for only ONE post-location combination based on their eligibility and interest. In case of multiple applications, only the latest application shall be considered.

Upload the required documents: recent passport size color photograph with signature, photo identity proof (PAN Card, Aadhar, Passport, Driving License, Voter ID), Class 10th Board Certificate (DOB proof), consolidated marksheet of MBBS/BHMS degree, MBBS/BHMS degree certificate, PG degree/diploma marksheets and certificates, DNB certificate (if applicable), training certificate in occupational health/public health/occupational medicine (if applicable), and proof of higher qualification (if any).

No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

howToApply: Visit the official IREL website at http://www.irel.co.in or the direct application link: https://cdn.digialm.com/EForms/configuredHtml/1258/100473/Index.html

Step-I: Register by filling in Personal Details and Contact Details. An OTP will be sent to your registered Mobile No. and E-mail ID. Verify both OTPs to complete registration. You will receive an Application Sequence Number (User ID) and Password.
Step-II: Re-login using the User ID and Password. Complete all fields including Personal Details, Additional Details, Communication Details, Qualification Details, and Declaration.
Upload all required documents including recent passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, min 100KB max 200KB, 3.5cm x 4.5cm) and signature (JPG/JPEG, min 80KB max 150KB).
Preview the application form and verify all details. Edit if necessary before final submission.
Submit the application and pay the applicable fee online via Payment Gateway (Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking/Wallets/UPI).
After successful payment, print and save the Application Form in PDF for future reference.
Candidates from Govt./PSU must forward their application through proper channel or produce NOC at the time of interview.
